advantages.title: Readable romanization
advantages.body: Every Thai word also appears in Latin phonetics with tone marks — readable from minute one, even without Thai script.

advantages.title: Tones and vowel length, tracked
advantages.body: Thai has five tones and distinguishes short from long vowels. Langsi marks both directly in the romanization instead of leaving it to guesswork.

advantages.title: Thai across different typefaces
advantages.body: Words are shown in several Thai typefaces so you get used to different handwriting and print styles — not just one single font.

advantages.title: Audio for word and sentence
advantages.body: Every single word and every full example sentence can be played aloud — right in your browser, at natural speaking speed.

advantages.title: Sentences broken into learnable chunks
advantages.body: Thai writes words without spaces between them. Langsi automatically splits every sentence into individual, understandable word groups.

pair_faq.q: Do I need to know Thai script to learn with Langsi?
pair_faq.a: No. Every word and sentence is also shown in Latin phonetics with tone marks — you can start right away and get used to Thai script gradually.

pair_faq.q: Is Langsi suitable for absolute Thai beginners?
pair_faq.a: Yes. The combination of meaning, audio, example sentences, and phonetics helps you learn new words in a clear context from day one — no prior knowledge needed.

pair_faq.q: Can I practice Thai pronunciation with Langsi?
pair_faq.a: Yes. Every word and example sentence can be played aloud, so you can train pronunciation and tones directly — not just read the script.

pair_faq.q: What does Langsi cost, and do I need to install anything?
pair_faq.a: You can start for free. Langsi runs directly in your browser, no installation needed — see the pricing section above for the details.
